I never write reviews, I'm usually happy with overall quality with what I buy online but this time I felt I needed to. I'm used to other premium inserts like E-Raptor or Laserox (wooden ones), but Prinsert really established a benchmark here, we're talking distinction levels, make no mistake. I love playing Emberleaf solo but the setup/teardown without an insert sometimes makes me leave the game on the shelf. Well, this insert helps not only with setup/teardown but you can see the designer was thinking "how can I pull the boxes from the box and integrate them with the game?". The worker boxes fit exactly their spaces, (FINALLY) card boxes that really allow sleeved cards, and the locations tiles tray is superb. I'm really speachless, it's not cheap but it's worth every penny.

Not the biggest fan of Deep Regrets but this insert makes the setup extremely easy. Simply pull the containers out of the box, shuffle the cards and you're ready to play. I really like the quality of the materials and I was pleasantly surprised to also get a guide on how each slot fits in the box and how I should organise them.
